en: A shadow swept over the pond, and Latias came down to land by the stone!
Latias flew off over the sea...
A shadow swept over the pond, and Latios came down to land by the stone!
was: Pokémonul eon a zburat peste mare și a dispărut pentru totdeauna...

en: Latios flew off over the sea...
was: O piatră netedă stă aici, tocită de ani. Ce s-a odihnit cândva pe ea a dispărut.

en: The eon Pokémon flew off over the sea, and was gone for good...
A smooth stone stands here, worn by the years. Whatever once rested on it is gone.
The eon Pokémon watches you closely.
